positions.title: Associate Strategist
positions.description:
-Coordinate with cross-functional teams to best plan and execute client projects.
-Review and revise internal reporting and client deliverables to maximize efficiency within account teams.
-Analyze brand communities and social metrics to generate insights that lead to more effective content creation.
-Manage client communities across social platforms including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and more.
-Oversaw a client brand pages’ growth from under 30K fans to over 1 million, leading to new company business.
-Train new employees in company ethos and practices to create a fun company culture and increase employee retention rate.
-Work in account teams to assist with client asks and deliver projects on time.
-Present research to internal teams to create educated client-facing recommendations.
-Optimize internal newsletter that was personalized and sent out to clients for account retention and lead generation.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
-Consult with local businesses to create an efficient strategy for social platforms.
-Organize and promote social events with clients to increase brand awareness.
-Assess campaign results to determine successes and failures to be delivered to clients for customer insight.

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
-Work closely with back-end operations (chefs, inventory, etc.)
-Host parties/events ranging from 10-60+ attendees
-Help monitor front-end operations (staff, bartenders, etc.)
-Deliver high quality customer service by responding effectively to customer needs
-Manage community on social platforms (Twitter, Facebook, etc.)
